name: motion-mcp
description: AI-native codebase-aware motion generation for existing apps, websites, and games.

interface.shortDescription: Add codebase-aware motion to existing apps.
interface.longDescription: Motion MCP researches an existing app flow, creates Rive-like page state-machine experience specs, chooses simple or premium SVG generation lanes, indexes generated assets, and emits framework-native state-machine animation code through MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Research this app for premium motion opportunities.
Create a Rive-like state-machine experience map for every page.
Decide whether this SVG should use the simple or premium lane.
Plan state-machine motion for this screen.
